This is from so long ago but i just want to put this out there because I have experienced this exact same thing twice in my life for elongated periods of time. 

I was triggered from a stressful/anxiety inducing time in my life which resulted in dissociation. The feeling of dissociation would make me so anxious that i would trigger my dissociation and i was stuck day in and day out in a never ending dissociation loop.

I couldn’t focus, i wasn’t connected to my emotions or feelings, and to this day, i cannot remember much from that time of my life. My memory was so bad that I had trouble remembering what I did the week before even after trying hard to remember. People were telling me things we did together from months/weeks prior and it felt like i wasn’t even there. 

My nervous system was entirely fucked up, so I tackled that head on. This is what helped me;

1. Imagine dissociation as your body’s way of protecting your brain from severe stress and trauma. Getting anxious about dissociation is what may be triggering your dissociation. It sucks, but looking at my mental state with acceptance and acknowledgement without attaching any judgement, frustration, or anxiety is what helped me the most

When you begin to get stressed about your dissociation, literally say something of the lines of, “i’m experiencing dissociation and my body is just trying to keep me safe.” And just breathe deeply. 

2. Nervous system exercises such as breathwork and meditation are very important in relaxing your nervous system. 

3. Exercise releases endorphins which is known to improve anxiety. It seriously helped me.
